design_intent: the opposed fingers, not the actuator, define the terminal silhouette
left and right contact pads face the grasp centerline
the palm provides one connected load path from J07 to both slider guides
J08 and J09 retain opposed prismatic motion and their frozen travel limits

interface_contract_updates.J07: compact planar palm mount with a continuous rigid load path
interface_contract_updates.J08: left rail carriage fused to the left finger root; travel corridor remains clear
interface_contract_updates.J09: right rail carriage fused to the right finger root; mirrored about the grasp centerline
interface_contract_updates.J10: tool frame remains virtual and lies between the opposed contact pads

acceptance_relations: finger members are visually distinct in front, top, and isometric views
both fingers extend beyond the palm along +X
contact pads turn inward toward the Y=0 grasp centerline
actuator remains proximal to the finger tips
each physical member is a single connected B-Rep solid
